name: FIVE HUNDRED
description: Five Hundred is a trick-taking game for four players in fixed partnerships, invented in the USA in 1904 and now the national card game of Australia. Players bid 6-10 tricks; the high bidder takes a 3-card kitty, discards 3 cards, declares trump, and attempts to win their bid. Features unique bower mechanics (Joker and jacks of matching suit as top trumps) and No Trump / Misere contract options. First partnership to reach 500+ points wins.

content.text: Five Hundred is a trick-taking game for four players in fixed partnerships, invented in the USA in 1904 and now the national card game of Australia. Players bid 6-10 tricks; the high bidder takes a 3-card kitty, discards 3 cards, declares trump, and attempts to win their bid. Features unique bower mechanics (Joker and jacks of matching suit as top trumps) and No Trump / Misere contract options. First partnership to reach 500+ points wins.

Five Hundred was invented in the USA in 1904 by the U.S. Playing Card Company, copyrighted officially in 1904. It evolved from Euchre, adding a 43-card pack (stripping 2s-6s) and a Joker, plus a bidding system for tricks and the 'kitty' (widow) mechanism.
Exactly 4 players in 2 fixed partnerships (seated opposite each other).
43-card deck: Remove all 2s, 3s, 4s, 5s, 6s from a standard 52-card deck, keeping 7-A in all suits. Add 1 Joker. Total: 43 cards + 1 Joker = 44 cards.

Dealer shuffles and right-hand player cuts. Dealer distributes: 3 cards to each player, then 3 cards to the kitty (widow), then 4 more cards to each player. Final distribution: each player holds 10 cards; 3-card kitty placed in center.

items.text: Three-Player Five Hundred: 5 cards dealt to each player, 5 cards to dummy. Highest bidder plays against two other players + dummy. Dummy plays according to standard rules.
Two-Player Five Hundred (Cutthroat): Each player bids alone. No partnerships. High bidder plays alone against opponent(s). 10 cards each, 4-card kitty.
Six-Player Five Hundred: 3 partnerships (3 players each, not all seated in standard order). Dealt 8-9 cards per player, 2-4 card kitty. Bidding and scoring adjusted.
Family Version (Simplified): Easier for beginners: bids limited to 6-8 tricks, no Misere contracts, simplified No Trump rules.
